info.title: Vaqcrow API
info.description: HTTP surface of the Vaqcrow demo API (TFM). Non-production: the KYC/KYB, the sales history and the ARS/asset conversion are simulated; Stellar runs on Testnet with no economic value. All failures are sanitized `{ code }` / `{ error }` envelopes. Auth is a Supabase Bearer JWT with roles PYME / INVERSOR / ADMIN.

bearerAuth.description: Supabase Auth access token. The API resolves the principal (role + user id) from it; a caller-supplied identity is never trusted.

ErrorResponse.description: Sanitized failure envelope. Always a stable `code` (and, for validation, an `errors` list); the provider's message/details/hint never cross this boundary.

error.description: A stable code used by a few routes (e.g. notifications, favorites).

errors.description: Field-level validation findings (400 on the routes that validate a body).
